patterns.key_values: ~200-230px source list, flat single nav group, monochrome SF Symbols, sentence-case labels, inset-rounded accent selection, brand lockup at top, action-bearing footer (capacity bar + primary Clean button)
content rows ~64-72px, circular checkbox + category glyph + bold title + 2-line secondary desc; rows near-invisibly separated (surface ~= bg tone, hairline stroke)
custom window-style popover (~18-20px radius), metadata header row ('2.9 GB to clean · 33m ago') + divider + ~50px action rows (Clean Safe Files/Scan now/Open Purge/Quit); not an NSMenu
result/completion card: centered stack, circled checkmark, display value, secondary caption, equivalence chips, tertiary footnote, full-width primary; sheet with no traffic lights
risk-filter pill row: three count-bearing capsules (All 42 / Safe to Clean 30 green-active / Check First 12) acting as scope segments; semantic green tint = safety tier

signature_moves: Risk-tiered item taxonomy as the primary control: Safe to Clean / Check First / All filter pills with live counts + green semantic tint, re-framing an irreversible bulk-delete as a triaged, forgiving decision (recurs in sidebar status and 'Clean Safe Items' button)
Reversibility written into the copy: never 'deleted' — 'moved to Trash' + 'Empty your Trash to reclaim this space'; destruction is always one undo away
Tangible-equivalents chips: freed GB re-expressed as '710 photos or 355 songs' — abstract space made experiential
defects: Contrast Dilution (surface separation) — content-row cards sample same ~#1F2024 tone as window bg; only an ~8-12% white hairline separates them, likely below the 3:1 non-text floor
Non-native control grammar — circular checkboxes for multi-select (rows + Select All) where macOS uses square checkboxes; systematic style choice, recorded as a native-tell
Marginal tertiary legibility — result-card reassurance footnote at ~25% white sits at the edge of readable

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (dark cool-neutral ramp + one semantic green), executed with native-macOS restraint rather than heavy custom chrome
peers: CleanMyMac (category peer, but Purge is far more restrained)

psychology: Forgiveness (Lidwell) — everything goes to Trash, reversible; 'Empty Trash to reclaim' makes destruction undoable by design
Loss aversion / risk framing (Kahneman-Tversky) — Safe-to-Clean vs Check-First taxonomy and green safe tier defuse the fear of deleting the wrong thing
Peak-End rule (Kahneman) — the result card invests in the flow's climax/end (2.98 GB moved, 'done in 0.3 seconds', tangible equivalents)
Description-experience gap (Hertwig & Erev) — GB re-expressed as photos/songs makes an abstract payoff felt
Von Restorff / action singularity — one prominent action per view ('Clean Safe Items', 'Done'); filters are toggles, not competing CTAs
Jakob's Law — reuses trained macOS patterns (source-list sidebar, MenuBarExtra) so a destructive tool still feels familiar
notes: All three surfaces are the app UI embedded inside 1280x720 marketing composites at an unknown down-scale — pixel-to-pt is NOT recoverable, so every token is (estimated) with wide ranges and no clean retina baseline. The marketing layer (matrix/data-dot black backdrop, heavy white SF-Pro-Rounded headlines, blue 'P' wordmark) is BRAND evidence, kept separate from the app UI. Lineage read as native SwiftUI (no Catalyst/Electron tells; strong Mac patterns) but with several consumer/iOS-leaning style choices (circular checkboxes, card-ified list rows, full-width white capsule primary) — med confidence. Era recorded liquid-glass for synthesis (Tahoe visual language: capsules, ~20px radii, translucent dark, rounded menu-bar highlight) but this is LOW confidence: surfaces are custom-drawn SwiftUI, no window chrome/traffic-lights are visible to date the frame, and dark-mode humility means true Liquid Glass cannot be distinguished from solid dark material in these stills. Single app, so nothing here is promotable to canon. No light-mode evidence; no settings/onboarding/text-input surfaces seen. An icon.png exists in the source but was out of scope (Workflow A / UI only).
